text: APPROVE. The patch moves the parse state into a nested `Reader` class and keeps the original branch order and conditions, including the `i + 1` line number. It also keeps the blank/comment skipping and the nullable flow, so behaviour looks unchanged. `Read` and the new helper methods each fall well under 15. The nested class can use `PnpmLock`'s private static helpers, so the build should be fine. I couldn't build it or see the body of `IsDependencySection`, which I'm assuming matches the old inline `is "dependencies" or "devDependencies" or "optionalDependencies"` check.
